about.title: Oasis Trip was born from a real need.
about.p1: For years, friends, family and acquaintances came to us to help them find the best prices on tickets, especially on the route between Brazil and Venezuela.
about.p2: Over time we understood that many people needed much more than a ticket: they needed guidance, trust and someone who truly knew the routes, the paperwork and the best options for traveling.
about.p3: That's how Oasis Trip was born. Today we help travelers across Latin America connect with their destinations safely, personally and with a human touch.

services.title: Complete solutions for every traveler
services.lead: From issuing the ticket to the last detail of your itinerary, we take care of everything.

connections.title: Specialists in the Brazil – Venezuela route
connections.lead: We make the connection between both countries easy, with air and land options adapted to each passenger. We plan the entire itinerary and support you from start to finish.

air.title: Air connection
air.desc: We organize your trip from any city in Brazil to Boa Vista (RR) and coordinate the continuation by air to Venezuela.
air.note: We also arrange the reverse route, from Venezuela to any city in Brazil.

land.title: Land connection
land.desc: For those who prefer to travel by road, we arrange the itinerary from any city in Brazil to Boa Vista, where we connect you with partner companies and drivers who handle the transfer to different destinations in Venezuela safely and reliably.
land.note: Likewise, we coordinate the trip from Venezuela to Boa Vista to continue to any city in Brazil.

connections.disclaimer: Important: Oasis Trip coordinates and organizes the travel itinerary. Land transfers are carried out by trusted partner companies and carriers.

routes.title: Some of the trips we coordinate most
routes.lead: And many more. If you don't see your route, write to us: we'll build it for you.

commitment.p2: We analyze the available options and recommend the most convenient one, always prioritizing safety, comfort and the best value for money.

venezuela.introText: We organize the complete route between any city in Brazil and Venezuela. We coordinate flights to Boa Vista (RR) and the continuation to Puerto Ordaz, Caracas or Porlamar, plus safe land connections with partner carriers.

features.title: Land connection
